INSERT INTO factory_main_hold (repo_url, base_branch, required_checks)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (repo_url, base_branch) DO UPDATE
            SET required_checks = EXCLUDED.required_checks,
                held_since = NULL,
                head_sha = NULL,
                failed = NULL,
                task_claimed_at = NULL,
                task_filed_at = NULL,
                task_id = NULL
